title: Signature Required
setup: A delivery drone hovers at the hatch, demanding a signature for the house upstairs.

options.label: Shoot it down
options.outcome: It drops a parcel: two cans and a satisfaction survey.

options.label: Thumbprint it
options.outcome: Logged as "Delivered." {name} stood a long minute in the dust for it.

options.label: Ignore it
options.outcome: It beeps politely until sundown. Nobody sleeps much.

title: Exterior Modification
setup: The HOA president is at the hatch. He says it breaks the neighbourhood guidelines.

options.label: Keep it locked
options.outcome: He tapes a violation notice to it. Fines are now theoretical.

options.label: Treat his cough
options.outcome: He waives the fine and leaves his flashlight.

options.label: Let him in to talk
options.outcome: He eats a can "as a courtesy" and leaves a copy of the bylaws.

title: One Bar
setup: {subject} keeps climbing the ladder, holding a phone up to the sky.

options.label: Try the radio instead
options.outcome: A broadcast names a supply drop at {nearest_school}. Worth a trip.

options.label: Let them keep trying
options.outcome: One text arrives: "Your order has shipped." {subject} took some dust for it.

options.label: Take the phone
options.outcome: {subject} sulks in the corner. The phone goes in a drawer.

title: Pending Update
setup: The smart fridge upstairs has locked itself to install an update. There's food inside.

options.label: Open it by hand
options.outcome: Two cans and a bottle. The fridge is now a cabinet.

options.label: Look up the hard reset
options.outcome: Factory settings restored. Two cans, and a chirpy welcome tune.

options.label: Wait for the update
options.outcome: The progress bar says 2%. It has said 2% for an hour.

title: Bunker Tour
setup: A man in a hazmat suit with a ring light is livestreaming "Day 6". Nobody has told him the internet is gone.

options.label: Give him a tour
options.outcome: He eats a ration "for the content." Everyone feels oddly famous.

options.label: Tell him the truth
options.outcome: He sits on the hatch a long while, then leaves the ring light behind.

options.label: Play him for his gear
options.outcome: You win his respirator. He takes it well, for a streamer.

title: Night Shift
setup: At 2 a.m. something bumps the hatch in a slow, patient pattern. It's the robot vacuum, still cleaning ash off the lawn.

options.label: Go out and get it

effects.what: fetched the vacuum through the dust

options.outcome: It docks by the radio and hums. Somehow that helps.

options.label: Name it and let it be
options.outcome: It's called Gerald now. Someone cries a little when the bumping stops.

options.label: Ignore it
options.outcome: Nobody sleeps.

title: Good Boy
setup: A retriever scratches at the hatch. His smart collar is still pinging an owner who stopped checking.

options.label: De-flea him and let him in
options.outcome: A clean dog. Everyone feels better than they have in days.

options.label: Feed him and send him off
options.outcome: He eats the whole can and trots off, looking pleased with himself.

options.label: Let him in as he is
options.outcome: Everyone's spirits lift. The fleas arrive tomorrow.

title: Motion Detected
setup: A stranger with a crowbar is checking houses. The doorbell camera upstairs keeps announcing him.

options.label: Signal him to keep moving
options.outcome: He flashes back "SORRY" and leaves a can by the hatch.

options.label: Lock up and wait
options.outcome: He tries the hatch twice and moves on. The lock holds.

options.label: Do nothing
options.outcome: He visits tonight. A padlock would have stopped him.

title: Unexpected Item
setup: At {place}, the self-checkouts are on backup power and complain every time {name} moves.

options.label: Go through the stockroom
options.outcome: The floor plan shows a stockroom door. One can and one bottle, quietly.

options.label: Grab and run
options.outcome: The noise draws two scavengers. {name} gets out, but not cleanly.

options.label: Scan everything politely
options.outcome: Forty minutes later: one can and a receipt nobody asked for.

title: Cabin Fever
setup: The argument about whose fault the smell is has reached its third hour.

options.label: Run a tournament
options.outcome: The finals are tense. Nobody remembers the smell.

options.label: Call a family meeting
options.outcome: You have accidentally founded an HOA.

options.label: Let it burn out
options.outcome: It does, eventually. {subject} refuses tomorrow's trip on principle.

title: Fizzy Rain
setup: The gutter barrel filled overnight. The water is grey and faintly fizzing.

options.label: Boil it the way chapter one says
options.outcome: It takes all afternoon and most of the patience. One bottle, safe.

options.label: Drink it as it is
options.outcome: Two bottles' worth. {subject} drank first and is now sick.

options.label: Leave it
options.outcome: It's still fizzing on day 14. Nobody asks why.

title: Model Home
setup: Near {place}, a staged show home has plastic fruit and a real pantry.

options.label: Pack the pantry
options.outcome: Three cans and a bottle. The plastic fruit stays.

options.label: Fill your pockets
options.outcome: One can, and a brochure about the clubhouse.

options.label: Try the realtor's lockbox
options.outcome: The code is 1234. Inside: keys to this house. {name} lingered too long in the dust.
